verdict.rationale: Pipecat is documented as an open-source Python framework. A hands-on probe confirmed the BSD-2 pipecat-ai package installs and imports with no key, and the docs say bot files are portable to most production self-hosting setups, including runs distributed across processes and machines. Missing for 10: a dedicated production self-hosting deployment guide in the evidence (e.g. scaling and orchestration on your own infrastructure), since the documented runner is development-focused.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
pypi pipecat-ai 1.8.1 (BSD-2 OSS) installs and `import pipecat` succeeds with no key, printing its startup banner — the open-source voice-agent framework is real, pip-installable, and self-hostable.
This is the property that makes the same bot file portable across the development runner, Pipecat Cloud, and most production self-hosting setups.
locally or distributed across processes and machines.
